name: Plan the Hunt

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text: You savor the anticipation of each hunt, carefully building it to your preference, but also planning for contingencies. You gain the Battle Planner feat, even if you don't meet its prerequisites, but you use Survival in place of Warfare Lore. Additionally, you gain the Prescient Planner feat.
